title: Snake Ladder
how_to_play: Steer with Arrow keys, WASD, or touch drag to collect emerald gems and golden ladder rungs while pressing Space or HOP to vault safely over the chasing snake.
description:
Snake Ladder reimagines the classic 1 to 100 board climb as a fast, tactile arcade chase inspired by Chai & Chakkar. You guide a nimble climber with a glowing amber tail across a warm, spiced-amber 10x10 neon board, racing from Tile 1 all the way to the Tile 100 summit while a coiled crimson snake hunts your trail.

Every emerald gem advances your position along the numbered board and adds to your score, while golden mini-ladder rungs launch you four tiles higher in a single burst. Collect gems within 1.4 seconds of each other to build a live chain multiplier that adds twenty-five percent per link, complete with floating combo popups, subtle board shake on high chains, and crisp synthesized chimes.

Timing your Ladder Hop is the key to survival. Pressing Space, Shift, or the on-screen HOP button launches your climber airborne with a burst of speed, letting you vault cleanly right over the snake's body and tail without taking a bite. Amber Shield orbs appear along the climb to stun the snake and protect your streak. Your active climb saves automatically so you can close the browser and hit Continue anytime, alongside a Top 5 climber leaderboard and daily play streak tracker.
controls: Mouse or Touch: Click and drag anywhere on the board to steer smoothly
Keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD to steer; Space or Shift to trigger Ladder Hop
Mobile: Tap the on-screen HOP button to vault over the chasing snake
Quick Keys: Press P to Pause or M to mute synthesized audio and vibration
tips: Trigger Ladder Hop right before crossing the snake's tail to vault safely over it.
Chain emerald gems within 1.4 seconds to stack your combo multiplier.
Prioritize golden mini-ladder rungs to jump four tiles closer to Tile 100.
Grab Amber Shield orbs to stun the snake and clear tight corners.
story: Inspired by childhood evenings playing Snakes & Ladders on a warm wooden board, Snake Ladder turns every climb into an agile reflex chase where one well-timed hop saves your run.

resume.how: Your active climb (score, current board tile, and shield state) saves automatically to localStorage after every pickup and restores via the Continue button on the home screen.

coins.why: Pure skill-based arcade climb with all features unlocked from the first run.
